question: Under what circumstances may the secret practice be revealed publicly?
premises: Publicity brings the gain of death
Such a result is to be avoided
Nothing justifies disclosure at any time
inference: Because publicity brings death, the practice must never be revealed.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of syānna as syāt+na is implied by sandhi.
plain_english: From publicity comes the gain of death; therefore it should never be revealed at any time.
